```python
class Forall(Expr):
    __slots__ = ('type','array_expr','binding','body')
    def eval(self, env):
        arr = self.array_expr.eval(env)
        b = self.binding
        had = b in env
        outer = env.get(b)
        try:
            for elem in arr:
                env[b] = elem
                if not self.body.eval(env):
                    return False
        finally:
            if had: env[b] = outer
            else: env.pop(b, None)
        return True
```
Using try/finally for correctness (no exceptions expected but safe). try/finally has negligible cost in 3.11 when no exception.
